items.description: Molecule converge playbook — creates expected filesystem state under /tmp/molecule_test/ (haproxy.cfg, conf.d fragments, error pages, logrotate config, directories)
items.notes: Recreates full filesystem state under /tmp/molecule_test/: haproxy.cfg with SSL/stats/global directives, three backend conf.d fragments (webservers/api/internal_monitoring), stick-tables.cfg, 503/408 error pages, logrotate config, and var/lib/haproxy directory. Uses inline copy content to avoid template rendering in converge. All loops use loop_var: item_haproxy_* with bracket notation.

items.description: Molecule verify playbook — checks /tmp/molecule_test/ paths: haproxy.cfg permissions (0640/root/haproxy), conf.d fragments, error pages (0644), logrotate (0644), /var/lib/haproxy dir (0750/haproxy/haproxy), haproxy config validation output
items.notes: Split into 4 plays to stay under 15-task limit per play. Play 1: core config files (haproxy.cfg, logrotate) with content assertions for SSL/stats/timeouts. Play 2: backend conf.d fragments with content assertions per backend. Play 3: error pages and directory structure. Play 4: service/port/socket/HTTP checks all tagged molecule-notest (cannot run in delegated container). All loops use prefixed loop_var and bracket notation. No registered variables interpolated into fail_msg strings.
